items.title: Predictive Modeling Project Context
items.summary: This project will develop a generic binary classification model for the following business objective: Develop a binary classification model that predicts the likelihood that a transaction is fraudulent before downstream financial loss occurs. The model output is intended to support this use: The model will generate a fraud risk score for each transaction. The model will predict Predict whether an individual transaction will ultimately be confirmed as fraudulent based on the organization's established fraud investigation an.. for All eligible payment transactions included within the development datasets that satisfy the defined business inclusion criteria. The observation window is defined as Transactions occurring during the defined model development period used to construct the TRAIN, TEST, and Out-of-Time (OOT) validation datasets; the performance window is Fraud outcomes are evaluated after a sufficient investigation and resolution period has elapsed so that each transaction can be assigned a finalize... The current deployment mode is Development. Dataset binding, target-column selection, validation design, and model selection will be established in later workflow stages.
